caption: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender chashu pork and crisp menma. Topped with shredded cabbage and a single nori sheet, it sits in a white bowl on a wooden table, bathed in warm, inviting light.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle light reflections.
Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with a slightly glistening surface and irregular, soft edges.
The nori seaweed is dark, glossy, triangular, with a slightly uneven, textured surface.
The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is rich amber, glossy, and contains visible noodles and shredded white toppings.
Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a soft, fibrous texture and irregular, curled shape.
White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
